description:
In Episode 230 we teamed up once again with Alex and James Bowen from Heritage and Hope, to interview one of the most well-known leaders in the Christian Nationalist movement: Douglas Wilson.
Is Christian Nationalism the future of the church or a dangerous distortion of the gospel? 

Douglas Wilson, senior pastor of Christ Church in Moscow, Idaho, has recently gained national attention through a viral CNN interview and has been featured in discussions with Tucker Carlson, Jared Longshore, Stephen Wolfe, and many others. 

In this conversation, we press him on some of the most controversial questions facing Christianity in America today -- from the tension between free will and coerced religion, to the separation of church and state, and the correct interpretation of Scripture.

We also explore the historical record, Protestant evidence, and prophetic implications that challenge many of his claims.
